metadata.title: Learnigo - Math / Speak
metadata.subject: Math
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question is scored by speech recognition against expected_keywords, not a single fixed transcript, so natural phrasing is accepted.
The module climbs from simple spoken number naming to teaching a maths concept aloud to an imagined learner, the deepest test of understanding.
speech_scoring.sample_answer shows one good answer for engineering/QA reference; expected_keywords define what actually triggers credit.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
This module has no reading or writing load at all, so it can reveal a child's true mental-maths reasoning independent of literacy skill.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Explain-your-method and teach-it-back items (12 and 15) are scored for genuine reasoning shown, not just a correct final number.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: converting a printed numeral into its spoken word
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline check that a written numeral connects to its correct spoken name.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: counting aloud while tracking a visual set
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms the count sequence is spoken correctly and lands on the right total.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: mental calculation spoken aloud with no visual or written support
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Pure mental maths - no fingers, no paper shown, just spoken reasoning and a spoken result.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: converting written symbols (+, -, =) into their spoken equivalents
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Confirms mathematical symbols are read correctly, a decoding skill distinct from calculating.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: retrieving and speaking a shape's correct name
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Speech-only geometry vocabulary check, isolated from reading or writing.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding two numbers in mind and speaking the comparison result
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Oral version of number comparison, testing the judgement without any visual symbols to lean on.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a skip-counting sequence entirely aloud, unprompted after the first few
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The oral production version of skip counting - a strong predictor of later multiplication fluency.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: generating an unprompted spoken sentence that includes a correct count
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether number sense transfers into natural, unprompted spoken description.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: converting a visual clock face into a spoken time
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Analogue clock reading spoken aloud, closer to how time is communicated in daily conversation.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: explaining, in words, what a pattern is doing rather than just continuing it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A step beyond pattern extension - putting the rule itself into words shows deeper understanding.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: producing a plausible quantity estimate without exact counting
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Estimation is a distinct, valuable skill from exact counting - useful when counting isn't practical.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: describing the steps of a mental process, not just stating its result
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A genuinely different skill from calculating - explaining process reveals understanding depth directly.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: demonstrating comprehension by retelling before calculating
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Separates comprehension from calculation - retelling first proves the story was actually understood.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding an intermediate spoken result in mind while completing a second step
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest oral working-memory task in the module - no paper, no typing, just mental tracking and speech.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reorganising understanding into a clear explanation for someone else
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - teaching something is widely recognised as the deepest test of understanding it.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Look at the number. Say it out loud.
hints: Say the whole number name in one go.
questions.worked_example: Look at the whole number, then say its name in one go.

feedback.correct: Three. Clearly said. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Look at the whole number, then say its name.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Saying numbers confidently is often the first sign they're truly known.

analysis.primary_construct: converting a printed numeral into its spoken word
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline check that a written numeral connects to its correct spoken name.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Saying digits one at a time (one-two for 12) instead of the whole number name is a specific, correctable pattern.
analysis.parent_note: Saying a number confidently out loud is often the first sign it's truly known, not just recognised.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice reading house numbers, page numbers, and clocks aloud together.

zh.instruction: 说出哪个数字更大,或更小。

ja.instruction: どちらの数が大きいか、小さいかを言おう。

ko.instruction: 어느 숫자가 더 큰지, 작은지 말해 보세요.
hints: 십의 자리를 비교하세요: 1인가요, 7인가요?
ko.worked_example: 두 숫자를 머릿속에 떠올리세요. 세었을 때 더 뒤에 오는 쪽을 말하세요.

id.instruction: Ucapkan angka mana yang lebih besar, atau lebih kecil.
hints: Bandingkan digit puluhannya: 1 atau 7?

feedback.correct: Tujuh belas lebih kecil - berhasil dibedakan dari kembarannya yang terbalik. 🔢

vi.instruction: Nói xem số nào lớn hơn, hoặc nhỏ hơn.

feedback.correct: Mười bảy nhỏ hơn - phân biệt đúng với số đảo ngược của nó. 🔢

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Say which number is bigger, or smaller.
hints: Work out both doubles before comparing, and say which is bigger.
questions.worked_example: Hold both numbers in mind. Say which one is further along if you count.

feedback.correct: Double nine (18) is bigger than double six (12). Correctly worked out and said. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Work out double 6 and double 9 first, then compare, then say your answer.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Even after calculating, pausing to actually compare the results matters.

analysis.primary_construct: holding two numbers in mind and speaking the comparison result
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Oral version of number comparison, testing the judgement without any visual symbols to lean on.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Repeating the second number heard (recency) rather than the mathematically bigger one shows memory load, not comparison error.
analysis.parent_note: Comparing sizes out loud is used constantly in real conversation - more, less, bigger, smaller.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Compare real quantities out loud throughout the day.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: double nine is bigger, because twelve is less than eighteen

id.instruction: Ucapkan angka mana yang lebih besar, atau lebih kecil.
hints: Hitung dulu kedua nilainya sebelum membandingkan.
id.worked_example: Ingat kedua angka itu. Ucapkan mana yang lebih jauh jika kamu menghitung.

feedback.correct: Sama besar! Keduanya menjadi lima - kejutan yang menyenangkan, berhasil dihitung dengan benar. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Hitung dulu masing-masing: setengah dari sepuluh, dan seperempat dari dua puluh, lalu bandingkan.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Nói xem số nào lớn hơn, hoặc nhỏ hơn.
vi.prompt: một nửa của 10 và một phần tư của 20
hints: Tính cả hai giá trị trước khi so sánh.
vi.worked_example: Nhớ cả hai số trong đầu. Nói xem số nào ở xa hơn nếu đếm tới.

feedback.correct: Bằng nhau! Cả hai đều ra năm - một bất ngờ thú vị, tính đúng. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Tính từng giá trị trước: một nửa của mười, và một phần tư của hai mươi, rồi so sánh.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: chúng bằng nhau, cả hai đều là năm

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Count out loud in twos, fives, or tens.
hints: Add two each time.
questions.worked_example: Say the rule to yourself first: 'add five each time.' Then count.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - skip counting in twos, correctly said. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Start at two, and add two each time as you say each number.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Counting in twos aloud is much faster than counting one at a time.

analysis.primary_construct: producing a skip-counting sequence entirely aloud, unprompted after the first few
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The oral production version of skip counting - a strong predictor of later multiplication fluency.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Reverting to counting by ones partway through shows the skip-count rule wasn't held for the full sequence.
analysis.parent_note: Skip counting fluently aloud now saves real effort in multiplication tables later.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice skip counting together during everyday moments - stairs, claps, steps.

es.instruction: Cuenta en voz alta de dos en dos, de cinco en cinco, o de diez en diez.
es.prompt: Cuenta de dos en dos hasta 10.
hints: Suma dos cada vez.
es.worked_example: Dite la regla primero a ti mismo: 'suma cinco cada vez'. Luego cuenta.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10: conteo de dos en dos, dicho correctamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Empieza en dos, y suma dos cada vez que dices un número.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Compte à voix haute de deux en deux, de cinq en cinq, ou de dix en dix.
fr.prompt: Compte de deux en deux jusqu'à 10.
hints: Ajoute deux chaque fois.
fr.worked_example: Dis-toi d'abord la règle : « on ajoute cinq chaque fois ». Puis compte.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - comptage de deux en deux, correctement dit. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Commence à deux, et ajoute deux chaque fois en disant chaque nombre.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Conte em voz alta de dois em dois, de cinco em cinco, ou de dez em dez.
pt.prompt: Conte de dois em dois até 10.
hints: Some dois cada vez.
pt.worked_example: Diga a regra para si mesmo primeiro: 'somar cinco cada vez.' Depois conte.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - contagem de dois em dois, dita corretamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Comece em dois, e some dois cada vez que disser cada número.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Conta ad alta voce per due, per cinque, o per dieci.
hints: Aggiungi due ogni volta.
it.worked_example: Di' a te stesso la regola per prima cosa: 'aggiungi cinque ogni volta.' Poi conta.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - conteggio a salti per due, detto correttamente. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Parti da due, e aggiungi due ogni volta mentre dici ogni numero.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Zähle laut in Zweier-, Fünfer- oder Zehnerschritten.
hints: Addiere jedes Mal zwei.
de.worked_example: Sag dir die Regel zuerst selbst: 'jedes Mal fünf addieren.' Dann zähle.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 – in Zweierschritten gezählt, richtig gesagt. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Starte bei zwei und addiere jedes Mal zwei, während du jede Zahl sagst.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Tel hardop in tweeën, vijven, of tienen.
hints: Tel er telkens twee bij.
nl.worked_example: Zeg eerst de regel tegen jezelf: 'tel er telkens vijf bij.' Tel dan.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - sprongetjes van twee, correct gezegd. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Begin bij twee, en tel er telkens twee bij terwijl je elk getal zegt.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Считай вслух по двое, по пять или по десять.
hints: Каждый раз прибавляй два.
ru.worked_example: Сначала скажи правило про себя: «каждый раз прибавляй пять». Затем считай.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 — счёт через два, сказано правильно. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Начни с двух и каждый раз прибавляй два, произнося каждое число.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Yüksek sesle ikişer, beşer ya da onar say.
hints: Her defasında iki ekle.
tr.worked_example: Önce kuralı kendine söyle: 'her defasında beş ekle.' Sonra say.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - ikişer sayma, doğru söylendi. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: İkiden başla, her sayıyı söylerken iki ekle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 大声数数,按2、5或10跳着数。
hints: 每次加二。
zh.worked_example: 先在心里说一遍规则:每次加五。然后再数。

feedback.incorrect: 从二开始,每说一个数就加二。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这一题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 2、5、10ずつ、声に出して数えよう。
hints: 毎回2を足そう。
ja.worked_example: まず「○ずつ足す」というルールを自分に言おう。それから数えよう。

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - 2ずつの数え上げを正しく言えたね。🔢
feedback.incorrect: 2から始めて、言うたびに2を足そう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: に、よん、ろく、はち、じゅう

ko.instruction: 둘씩, 다섯씩, 열씩 소리 내어 세어 보세요.
hints: 매번 2를 더하세요.
ko.worked_example: 먼저 규칙을 스스로 말해 보세요: '매번 다섯을 더해요.' 그런 다음 세어 보세요.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - 둘씩 뛰어 세기를 정확히 말했어요. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: 2부터 시작해서 숫자를 말할 때마다 2씩 더하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Hitung dengan lantang dalam kelipatan dua, lima, atau sepuluh.
hints: Tambahkan dua setiap kali.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan dulu aturannya dalam hati: 'tambah lima setiap kali.' Lalu mulai menghitung.

feedback.correct: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 - berhitung lompat dalam kelipatan dua, diucapkan dengan benar. 🔢

vi.instruction: Đếm to theo hai, năm, hoặc mười.
hints: Mỗi lần cộng thêm hai.
vi.worked_example: Tự nói quy tắc trước: 'mỗi lần cộng thêm năm.' Rồi đếm.

feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Count out loud in twos, fives, or tens.
hints: Add three each time.
questions.worked_example: Say the rule to yourself first: 'add five each time.' Then count.

feedback.correct: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 - skip counting in threes, correctly said. 🔢
feedback.incorrect: Start at three, and add three each time.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Threes are a pattern that leads directly into the three-times table.

analysis.primary_construct: producing a skip-counting sequence entirely aloud, unprompted after the first few
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The oral production version of skip counting - a strong predictor of later multiplication fluency.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Reverting to counting by ones partway through shows the skip-count rule wasn't held for the full sequence.
analysis.parent_note: Skip counting fluently aloud now saves real effort in multiplication tables later.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Practice skip counting together during everyday moments - stairs, claps, steps.

questions.subject: Math

questions.subject: Math

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to the problem. Retell it in your own words, then solve it.
questions.audio_text: A shop had 32 loaves. It sold 18, then baked 10 more. How many loaves does it have now?
hints: Retell all the events in order, then solve the two steps.
questions.worked_example: Say the story back in your own words first. Then work out the answer.

feedback.correct: Story retold accurately, and correctly solved across two steps: twenty-four. 🍞
feedback.incorrect: Retell all three events in order first, then work through both steps.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: paraphrasing and solving a word problem aloud

life_skill.primary: Retelling and solving a two-step story
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Retelling a multi-step story accurately is real comprehension in action.

analysis.primary_construct: demonstrating comprehension by retelling before calculating
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Separates comprehension from calculation - retelling first proves the story was actually understood.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A correct final answer despite an inaccurate retelling suggests the calculation, not real comprehension, drove the result.
analysis.parent_note: Asking for a retelling before an answer is a great way to check real understanding, not just lucky guessing.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'what's this story about?' before asking for any calculation.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The shop had thirty-two loaves, sold eighteen, then baked ten more, leaving twenty-four.

es.instruction: Escucha el problema. Cuéntalo con tus propias palabras y luego resuélvelo.

fr.instruction: Écoute le problème. Raconte-le dans tes propres mots, puis résous-le.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A loja tinha trinta e dois pães, vendeu dezoito, depois assou mais dez, sobrando vinte e quatro.

life_skill.primary: Retelling and solving a two-step story about money

speech_scoring.sample_answer: The charity collected forty-five pounds Saturday and thirty-two Sunday, then spent twenty, leaving fifty-seven.

es.instruction: Escucha el problema. Cuéntalo con tus propias palabras y luego resuélvelo.
es.audio_text: Una organización benéfica recaudó 45 libras el sábado y 32 el domingo, y luego gastó 20 en suministros. ¿Cuánto queda?
hints: Cuenta todos los eventos en orden, y luego resuelve los dos pasos.
es.worked_example: Cuenta la historia con tus propias palabras primero. Luego calcula la respuesta.

feedback.correct: Historia recontada con precisión, y resuelta correctamente en dos pasos: cincuenta y siete. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Cuenta primero los tres eventos en orden, y luego resuelve los dos pasos.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: La organización benéfica recaudó cuarenta y cinco libras el sábado y treinta y dos el domingo, y luego gastó veinte, quedando cincuenta y siete.

fr.instruction: Écoute le problème. Raconte-le dans tes propres mots, puis résous-le.
fr.audio_text: Une association caritative a collecté 45 livres le samedi et 32 le dimanche, puis a dépensé 20 en fournitures. Combien reste-t-il ?
hints: Raconte tous les événements dans l'ordre, puis résous les deux étapes.
fr.worked_example: Raconte d'abord l'histoire dans tes propres mots. Puis calcule la réponse.

feedback.correct: Histoire racontée fidèlement, et correctement résolue en deux étapes : cinquante-sept. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Raconte d'abord les trois événements dans l'ordre, puis résous les deux étapes.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: L'association a collecté quarante-cinq livres samedi et trente-deux dimanche, puis a dépensé vingt, ce qui laisse cinquante-sept.

pt.instruction: Escute o problema. Reconte com as suas próprias palavras, depois resolva.
pt.audio_text: Uma instituição de caridade arrecadou 45 libras no sábado e 32 no domingo, depois gastou 20 em suprimentos. Quanto sobrou?
hints: Reconte todos os eventos em ordem, depois resolva os dois passos.
pt.worked_example: Primeiro, reconte a história com as suas próprias palavras. Depois calcule a resposta.

feedback.correct: História recontada com precisão, e resolvida corretamente em dois passos: cinquenta e sete. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Reconte primeiro os três eventos em ordem, depois resolva os dois passos.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A instituição de caridade arrecadou quarenta e cinco libras no sábado e trinta e duas no domingo, depois gastou vinte, sobrando cinquenta e sete.

it.instruction: Ascolta il problema. Raccontalo con le tue parole, poi risolvilo.
it.audio_text: Un'associazione benefica ha raccolto 45 sterline sabato e 32 domenica, poi ha speso 20 in materiali. Quanto resta?
hints: Racconta tutti gli eventi in ordine, poi risolvi i due passaggi.
it.worked_example: Racconta prima la storia con le tue parole. Poi calcola la risposta.

feedback.correct: Storia raccontata con precisione, e risolta correttamente in due passaggi: cinquantasette. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Racconta tutti e tre gli eventi in ordine prima, poi risolvi entrambi i passaggi.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: L'associazione ha raccolto quarantacinque sterline sabato e trentadue domenica, poi ne ha spese venti, restandone cinquantasette.

de.instruction: Hör dir die Aufgabe an. Erzähle sie in deinen eigenen Worten nach und löse sie dann.
de.audio_text: Eine Wohltätigkeitsorganisation sammelte am Samstag 45 Pfund und am Sonntag 32, und gab dann 20 für Material aus. Wie viel bleibt übrig?
hints: Erzähl alle Ereignisse in der richtigen Reihenfolge nach und löse dann die zwei Schritte.
de.worked_example: Erzähl die Geschichte zuerst in deinen eigenen Worten nach. Rechne dann die Antwort aus.

feedback.correct: Geschichte genau nacherzählt und über zwei Schritte richtig gelöst: siebenundfünfzig. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Erzähl zuerst alle drei Ereignisse in der richtigen Reihenfolge nach, und arbeite dann beide Schritte durch.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Die Wohltätigkeitsorganisation sammelte am Samstag fünfundvierzig Pfund und am Sonntag zweiunddreißig, gab dann zwanzig aus, sodass siebenundfünfzig übrig blieben.

nl.instruction: Luister naar het probleem. Vertel het in je eigen woorden opnieuw, en los het dan op.
nl.audio_text: Een goed doel verzamelde 45 pond op zaterdag en 32 op zondag, en gaf toen 20 uit aan benodigdheden. Hoeveel is er nog over?
hints: Vertel alle gebeurtenissen in volgorde na, en los dan de twee stappen op.
nl.worked_example: Vertel het verhaal eerst na in je eigen woorden. Werk dan het antwoord uit.

feedback.correct: Verhaal accuraat naverteld, en correct opgelost over twee stappen: zevenenvijftig. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Vertel alle drie de gebeurtenissen eerst in volgorde na, en werk dan beide stappen uit.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Het goede doel verzamelde vijfenveertig pond op zaterdag en tweeëndertig op zondag, en gaf toen twintig uit, waardoor er zevenenvijftig overbleven.

ru.instruction: Слушай задачу. Перескажи её своими словами, а затем решай.
ru.audio_text: Благотворительная организация собрала 45 фунтов в субботу и 32 в воскресенье, затем потратила 20 на материалы. Сколько осталось?
hints: Перескажи все события по порядку, затем реши в два шага.
ru.worked_example: Сначала перескажи историю своими словами. Затем найди ответ.

feedback.correct: История пересказана точно, и верно решено в два шага: пятьдесят семь. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Сначала перескажи все три события по порядку, затем пройди оба шага.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Организация собрала сорок пять фунтов в субботу и тридцать два в воскресенье, затем потратила двадцать, осталось пятьдесят семь.

tr.instruction: Problemi dinle. Kendi sözlerinle yeniden anlat, sonra çöz.
tr.audio_text: Bir yardım kurumu cumartesi günü 45 pound, pazar günü 32 pound topladı, sonra malzemeler için 20 pound harcadı. Kaç pound kaldı?
hints: Tüm olayları sırayla yeniden anlat, sonra iki adımı çöz.
tr.worked_example: Önce hikayeyi kendi sözlerinle anlat. Sonra cevabı bul.

feedback.correct: Hikaye doğru şekilde yeniden anlatıldı ve iki adımda doğru çözüldü: elli yedi. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Önce üç olayı da sırayla yeniden anlat, sonra her iki adımı da çöz.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Yardım kurumu cumartesi kırk beş, pazar otuz iki pound topladı, sonra yirmi pound harcadı, geriye elli yedi pound kaldı.

zh.instruction: 听这道题。用自己的话重新说一遍,再解答。
hints: 按顺序复述所有事情,再解答两个步骤。
zh.worked_example: 先用自己的话把这个故事说一遍,再算出答案。

feedback.correct: 故事复述得很准确,两个步骤也都正确解答了:五十七。💷
feedback.incorrect: 先按顺序复述这三件事,再完成两个步骤的计算。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这一题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 慈善机构星期六收到四十五英镑,星期天收到三十二英镑,又花掉二十英镑,所以还剩五十七英镑。

ja.instruction: 問題を聞いて、自分の言葉で言い直してから答えよう。
ja.audio_text: チャリティーは土曜日に45ポンド、日曜日に32ポンド集め、それから物資に20ポンド使いました。残りはいくらですか？
hints: 出てきたことを順番に言い直してから、2つのステップを解こう。
ja.worked_example: まず話を自分の言葉で言い直そう。それから答えを出そう。

feedback.correct: 話を正確に言い直せて、2つのステップを正しく解けたね。57だよ。💷
feedback.incorrect: まず3つの出来事を順番に言い直して、それから両方のステップを解こう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: チャリティーは土曜日に45ポンド、日曜日に32ポンド集めて、それから20ポンド使ったから、残りは57ポンドだよ。

ko.instruction: 문제를 듣고, 자신의 말로 다시 말한 다음, 풀어 보세요.
ko.audio_text: 어느 자선단체가 토요일에 45파운드, 일요일에 32파운드를 모으고, 물품에 20파운드를 썼어요. 얼마가 남았나요?
hints: 모든 사건을 순서대로 다시 말한 다음, 두 단계를 풀어 보세요.
ko.worked_example: 먼저 이야기를 자신의 말로 다시 말하세요. 그런 다음 답을 구하세요.

feedback.correct: 이야기를 정확히 다시 말했고, 두 단계 모두 정확히 풀었어요: 오십칠. 💷
feedback.incorrect: 세 가지 사건을 순서대로 모두 다시 말한 다음, 두 단계를 모두 풀어 보세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 자선단체가 토요일에 45파운드, 일요일에 32파운드를 모으고 20파운드를 써서 57파운드가 남았어요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan soalnya. Ceritakan ulang dengan kata-katamu sendiri, lalu selesaikan.
id.audio_text: Sebuah badan amal mengumpulkan 45 pound pada hari Sabtu dan 32 pada hari Minggu, lalu menghabiskan 20 untuk perlengkapan. Berapa sisanya?

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Badan amal itu mengumpulkan empat puluh lima pound pada hari Sabtu dan tiga puluh dua pada hari Minggu, lalu menghabiskan dua puluh, sehingga sisanya lima puluh tujuh.

vi.instruction: Nghe bài toán. Kể lại bằng lời của bạn, rồi giải nó.
vi.audio_text: Một quỹ từ thiện thu được 45 bảng vào thứ Bảy và 32 bảng vào Chủ Nhật, rồi chi 20 bảng cho vật dụng. Hỏi còn lại bao nhiêu?
hints: Kể lại tất cả các sự việc theo thứ tự, rồi giải hai bước.
vi.worked_example: Nói lại câu chuyện bằng lời của bạn trước. Rồi tính ra đáp án.

feedback.correct: Kể lại câu chuyện chính xác, và giải đúng qua hai bước: năm mươi bảy. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Kể lại cả ba sự việc theo thứ tự trước, rồi tính qua cả hai bước.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Quỹ từ thiện thu được bốn mươi lăm bảng vào thứ Bảy và ba mươi hai bảng vào Chủ Nhật, rồi chi hai mươi bảng, còn lại năm mươi bảy bảng.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: Listen to the problem. Retell it in your own words, then solve it.
questions.audio_text: Tia broke a cup by accident. She felt scared. She told her mum straight away, and her mum thanked her for being honest.

questions.worked_example: Say the story back in your own words first. Then work out the answer.

feedback.correct: Story retold accurately, including both the feeling and the brave choice. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Retell the story, making sure to include how Tia felt, not just what happened.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: paraphrasing and solving a word problem aloud

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Retelling a story's feelings, not just its events, shows deeper comprehension.

analysis.primary_construct: demonstrating comprehension by retelling before calculating
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Separates comprehension from calculation - retelling first proves the story was actually understood.
analysis.behaviour_watch: A correct final answer despite an inaccurate retelling suggests the calculation, not real comprehension, drove the result.
analysis.parent_note: Asking for a retelling before an answer is a great way to check real understanding, not just lucky guessing.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask 'what's this story about?' before asking for any calculation.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia broke a cup by accident, felt scared, but told her mum right away, and her mum thanked her for being honest.

es.instruction: Escucha el problema. Cuéntalo con tus propias palabras y luego resuélvelo.

es.worked_example: Cuenta la historia con tus propias palabras primero. Luego calcula la respuesta.

feedback.correct: Historia recontada con precisión, incluyendo tanto el sentimiento como la decisión valiente. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Cuenta la historia de nuevo, asegurándote de incluir cómo se sintió Tia, no solo lo que pasó.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia rompió una taza por accidente, se sintió asustada, pero se lo dijo a su mamá enseguida, y su mamá le agradeció por ser honesta.

fr.instruction: Écoute le problème. Raconte-le dans tes propres mots, puis résous-le.
fr.audio_text: Tia a cassé une tasse par accident. Elle s'est sentie effrayée. Elle l'a dit tout de suite à sa maman, qui l'a remerciée d'avoir été honnête.

feedback.incorrect: Raconte l'histoire, en veillant à inclure ce que Tia a ressenti, pas seulement ce qui s'est passé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia a cassé une tasse par accident, s'est sentie effrayée, mais l'a dit tout de suite à sa maman, qui l'a remerciée d'avoir été honnête.

pt.instruction: Escute o problema. Reconte com as suas próprias palavras, depois resolva.

pt.worked_example: Primeiro, reconte a história com as suas próprias palavras. Depois calcule a resposta.

feedback.correct: História recontada com precisão, incluindo o sentimento e a escolha corajosa. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Reconte a história, certificando-se de incluir como a Tia se sentiu, não apenas o que aconteceu.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: A Tia quebrou uma xícara por acidente, ficou com medo, mas contou para a mãe imediatamente, e a mãe agradeceu por ela ter sido honesta.

it.instruction: Ascolta il problema. Raccontalo con le tue parole, poi risolvilo.

it.worked_example: Racconta prima la storia con le tue parole. Poi calcola la risposta.

feedback.incorrect: Racconta la storia, assicurandoti di includere come si è sentita Tia, non solo cosa è successo.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia ha rotto una tazza per sbaglio, si è sentita spaventata, ma l'ha detto subito a sua mamma, e sua mamma l'ha ringraziata per essere stata onesta.

de.instruction: Hör dir die Aufgabe an. Erzähle sie in deinen eigenen Worten nach und löse sie dann.
de.audio_text: Tia zerbrach versehentlich eine Tasse. Sie hatte Angst. Sie erzählte es sofort ihrer Mama, und ihre Mama dankte ihr dafür, ehrlich zu sein.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia zerbrach versehentlich eine Tasse, hatte Angst, erzählte es aber sofort ihrer Mama, und ihre Mama dankte ihr dafür, ehrlich zu sein.

nl.instruction: Luister naar het probleem. Vertel het in je eigen woorden opnieuw, en los het dan op.

feedback.incorrect: Vertel het verhaal na, en vermeld zeker hoe Tia zich voelde, niet alleen wat er gebeurde.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia brak per ongeluk een kopje, was bang, maar vertelde het meteen aan haar moeder, en haar moeder bedankte haar voor haar eerlijkheid.

ru.instruction: Слушай задачу. Перескажи её своими словами, а затем решай.

feedback.incorrect: Перескажи историю, не забыв рассказать о чувствах Тиа, а не только о событиях.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Тиа случайно разбила чашку, испугалась, но сразу рассказала маме, и мама поблагодарила её за честность.

tr.instruction: Problemi dinle. Kendi sözlerinle yeniden anlat, sonra çöz.

feedback.correct: Hikaye, hem hissettiği duyguyu hem de cesur seçimi içerecek şekilde doğru olarak yeniden anlatıldı. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Hikayeyi, sadece ne olduğunu değil Tia'nın nasıl hissettiğini de dahil ederek yeniden anlat.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia kazayla bir fincan kırdı, korktu, ama hemen annesine söyledi ve annesi dürüst olduğu için ona teşekkür etti.

feedback.correct: 故事复述得很准确,既包含了感受,也包含了这个勇敢的选择。💛
feedback.incorrect: 复述这个故事,记得说出Tia的感受,不只是发生了什么。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这一题——看看是怎么做的。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia不小心打碎了一个杯子,她感到害怕,但还是马上告诉了妈妈,妈妈谢谢她的诚实。

ja.instruction: 問題を聞いて、自分の言葉で言い直してから答えよう。
ja.audio_text: ティアはうっかりコップを割ってしまいました。怖くなりました。すぐにお母さんに話し、お母さんは正直に言ってくれてありがとうと言いました。
ja.correct_answer: 言い直してから説明する
accepted_answers: 言い直してから説明する
hints: ティアがどう感じたか、何をしたかも含めて、話全体を言い直そう。
ja.worked_example: まず話を自分の言葉で言い直そう。それから答えを出そう。

feedback.correct: 気持ちの部分と、勇気ある選択の両方を含めて、正確に話を言い直せたね。💛
feedback.incorrect: 何が起きたかだけでなく、ティアがどう感じたかも含めて話を言い直そう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

speech_scoring.sample_answer: ティアはうっかりコップを割ってしまって怖くなったけど、すぐにお母さんに話して、お母さんは正直に言ってくれたことにお礼を言ったよ。

ko.instruction: 문제를 듣고, 자신의 말로 다시 말한 다음, 풀어 보세요.
ko.audio_text: 티아는 실수로 컵을 깨뜨렸어요. 무서웠어요. 바로 엄마에게 말했고, 엄마는 정직해줘서 고맙다고 했어요.
hints: 티아가 어떤 기분이었는지, 무엇을 선택했는지 포함해서 이야기 전체를 다시 말하세요.
ko.worked_example: 먼저 이야기를 자신의 말로 다시 말하세요. 그런 다음 답을 구하세요.

feedback.correct: 이야기를 정확히 다시 말했고, 기분과 용기 있는 선택까지 모두 포함했어요. 💛
feedback.incorrect: 무슨 일이 있었는지뿐 아니라 티아의 기분도 꼭 포함해서 이야기를 다시 말하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: 티아는 실수로 컵을 깨뜨려서 무서웠지만, 바로 엄마에게 말했고, 엄마는 정직해줘서 고맙다고 했어요.

id.instruction: Dengarkan soalnya. Ceritakan ulang dengan kata-katamu sendiri, lalu selesaikan.
id.audio_text: Tia memecahkan cangkir secara tidak sengaja. Dia merasa takut. Dia langsung memberitahu ibunya, dan ibunya berterima kasih karena dia jujur.
hints: Ceritakan ulang seluruh kisahnya, termasuk apa yang Tia rasakan dan apa yang dia pilih untuk lakukan.
id.worked_example: Ceritakan ulang kisahnya dengan kata-katamu sendiri dulu. Lalu cari jawabannya.

feedback.correct: Kisah diceritakan ulang dengan tepat, termasuk perasaan dan pilihan yang berani. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Ceritakan ulang kisahnya, pastikan menyebutkan apa yang Tia rasakan, bukan hanya apa yang terjadi.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia memecahkan cangkir secara tidak sengaja, merasa takut, tapi langsung memberitahu ibunya, dan ibunya berterima kasih karena dia jujur.

vi.instruction: Nghe bài toán. Kể lại bằng lời của bạn, rồi giải nó.
vi.audio_text: Tia vô tình làm vỡ một cái cốc. Cô cảm thấy sợ. Cô nói ngay với mẹ, và mẹ cảm ơn cô vì đã trung thực.
hints: Kể lại toàn bộ câu chuyện, bao gồm cảm giác của Tia và điều cô đã chọn làm.
vi.worked_example: Nói lại câu chuyện bằng lời của bạn trước. Rồi tính ra đáp án.

feedback.correct: Kể lại câu chuyện chính xác, bao gồm cả cảm giác và quyết định can đảm. 💛
feedback.incorrect: Kể lại câu chuyện, nhớ bao gồm cảm giác của Tia, không chỉ những gì đã xảy ra.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

speech_scoring.sample_answer: Tia vô tình làm vỡ một cái cốc, cảm thấy sợ, nhưng nói ngay với mẹ, và mẹ cảm ơn cô vì đã trung thực.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: This one has two steps. Say your answer.
questions.audio_text: Ana has 10 coins. She spends 3 on a toy and 2 on a snack. How many coins are left?
hints: Take away the toy cost, then take away the snack cost too.
questions.worked_example: Say the first answer out loud. Hold it in mind. Now do the second step.

feedback.correct: Five. Both steps done correctly, entirely in your head. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Do it in two steps in your head: 10-3 first, then take away 2 more.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: solving and speaking a two-step problem

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Tracking two spends in a row, in your head, is exactly how real budgeting works.

analysis.primary_construct: holding an intermediate spoken result in mind while completing a second step
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest oral working-memory task in the module - no paper, no typing, just mental tracking and speech.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Speaking only the first step's result is the clearest possible spoken working-memory signature.
analysis.parent_note: Solving two steps entirely in your head and aloud is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying the first step's answer aloud before starting the second step.

es.instruction: Este tiene dos pasos. Di tu respuesta.
es.audio_text: Ana tiene 10 monedas. Gasta 3 en un juguete y 2 en un bocadillo. ¿Cuántas monedas le quedan?
hints: Quita el costo del juguete, y luego quita también el del bocadillo.
es.worked_example: Di la primera respuesta en voz alta. Guárdala en tu mente. Ahora haz el segundo paso.

feedback.correct: Cinco. Ambos pasos hechos correctamente, completamente de memoria. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Hazlo en dos pasos de memoria: primero 10-3, y luego quita 2 más.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Celui-ci a deux étapes. Dis ta réponse.
fr.audio_text: Ana a 10 pièces. Elle en dépense 3 pour un jouet et 2 pour un snack. Combien de pièces reste-t-il ?
hints: Enlève le coût du jouet, puis enlève aussi le coût du snack.
fr.worked_example: Dis la première réponse à voix haute. Garde-la en tête. Fais maintenant la deuxième étape.

feedback.correct: Cinq. Les deux étapes faites correctement, entièrement de tête. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Fais-le en deux étapes de tête : d'abord 10-3, puis enlève 2 de plus.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Esta tem dois passos. Diga a sua resposta.
pt.audio_text: A Ana tem 10 moedas. Ela gasta 3 num brinquedo e 2 num lanche. Quantas moedas sobram?
hints: Tire o custo do brinquedo, depois tire também o custo do lanche.
pt.worked_example: Diga a primeira resposta em voz alta. Guarde-a na memória. Agora faça o segundo passo.

feedback.correct: Cinco. Os dois passos feitos corretamente, tudo de cabeça. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Faça em dois passos de cabeça: primeiro 10-3, depois tire mais 2.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Questo ha due passaggi. Di' la tua risposta.
it.audio_text: Ana ha 10 monete. Ne spende 3 per un giocattolo e 2 per uno snack. Quante monete restano?
hints: Togli il costo del giocattolo, poi togli anche il costo dello snack.

feedback.correct: Cinque. Entrambi i passaggi fatti correttamente, tutto a mente. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Fallo in due passaggi a mente: prima 10-3, poi togli altre 2.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Diese Aufgabe hat zwei Schritte. Sag deine Antwort.
de.audio_text: Ana hat 10 Münzen. Sie gibt 3 für ein Spielzeug aus und 2 für einen Snack. Wie viele Münzen bleiben übrig?
hints: Zieh die Kosten für das Spielzeug ab, und zieh dann auch die Kosten für den Snack ab.

feedback.incorrect: Mach es im Kopf in zwei Schritten: zuerst 10-3, dann noch 2 abziehen.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Dit heeft twee stappen. Zeg je antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Ana heeft 10 munten. Ze geeft er 3 uit aan een speeltje en 2 aan een snack. Hoeveel munten heeft ze nog over?
hints: Trek de prijs van het speeltje af, en trek dan ook de snack af.
nl.worked_example: Zeg het eerste antwoord hardop. Houd het in gedachten. Doe nu de tweede stap.

feedback.correct: Vijf. Beide stappen correct gedaan, helemaal in je hoofd. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Doe het in twee stappen in je hoofd: eerst 10-3, en trek er dan nog 2 af.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: В этом задании два шага. Скажи свой ответ.
ru.audio_text: У Аны 10 монет. Она тратит 3 на игрушку и 2 на снек. Сколько монет осталось?
hints: Отними стоимость игрушки, потом отними ещё стоимость снека.
ru.worked_example: Произнеси первый ответ вслух. Запомни его. Теперь сделай второй шаг.

feedback.correct: Пять. Оба шага выполнены верно, полностью в уме. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Сделай это в два шага в уме: сначала 10-3, потом отними ещё 2.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Bunun iki adımı var. Cevabını söyle.
tr.audio_text: Ana'nın 10 madeni parası var. 3'ünü bir oyuncağa, 2'sini de bir atıştırmalığa harcıyor. Kaç madeni parası kaldı?
hints: Oyuncağın maliyetini çıkar, sonra atıştırmalığın maliyetini de çıkar.
tr.worked_example: İlk cevabı yüksek sesle söyle. Zihninde tut. Şimdi ikinci adımı yap.

feedback.incorrect: Kafadan iki adımda yap: önce 10-3, sonra 2 daha çıkar.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 这道题有两个步骤。说出你的答案。
hints: 先减去玩具的价格,再减去零食的价格。

feedback.incorrect: 分两步在心里算:先算10-3,再减2。

ja.instruction: これは2つのステップがあるよ。答えを言おう。
ja.audio_text: アナはコインを10個持っています。おもちゃに3個、おやつに2個使いました。残りは何個ですか？
hints: おもちゃの分を引いて、それからおやつの分も引こう。

feedback.incorrect: 2つのステップでやろう。まず10−3、それから2を引こう。

ko.instruction: 이 문제는 두 단계예요. 답을 말하세요.

hints: 장난감 비용을 뺀 다음, 과자 비용도 빼세요.

feedback.correct: 오. 두 단계 모두 머릿속으로 정확히 풀었어요. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: 머릿속으로 두 단계로 풀어보세요: 먼저 10-3, 그다음 2를 더 빼세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Soal ini punya dua langkah. Ucapkan jawabanmu.
id.audio_text: Ana punya 10 koin. Dia menghabiskan 3 untuk mainan dan 2 untuk camilan. Berapa koin yang sisa?
hints: Kurangi harga mainan, lalu kurangi harga camilan juga.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan jawaban pertama dengan lantang. Simpan dalam pikiranmu. Sekarang kerjakan langkah kedua.

feedback.correct: Lima. Kedua langkah dikerjakan dengan benar, sepenuhnya dalam pikiran. 🪙
feedback.incorrect: Kerjakan dalam dua langkah di kepalamu: 10-3 dulu, lalu kurangi 2 lagi.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Câu này có hai bước. Nói đáp án của bạn.
vi.audio_text: Ana có 10 đồng xu. Cô chi 3 đồng cho một món đồ chơi và 2 đồng cho một món ăn vặt. Hỏi còn lại bao nhiêu đồng xu?
hints: Trừ đi giá đồ chơi, rồi trừ tiếp giá món ăn vặt.

feedback.incorrect: Làm theo hai bước trong đầu: 10-3 trước, rồi trừ thêm 2.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

academic.skill: solving and speaking a two-step problem

life_skill.primary: Solving a two-step problem about time mentally
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Planning your own time means tracking more than one activity at once, in your head.

analysis.primary_construct: holding an intermediate spoken result in mind while completing a second step
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest oral working-memory task in the module - no paper, no typing, just mental tracking and speech.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Speaking only the first step's result is the clearest possible spoken working-memory signature.
analysis.parent_note: Solving two steps entirely in your head and aloud is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying the first step's answer aloud before starting the second step.

hints: Trek er eerst 6 af, en tel er dan 3 bij.
nl.worked_example: Zeg het eerste antwoord hardop. Houd het in gedachten. Doe nu de tweede stap.

feedback.correct: Vijftien. Beide stappen correct gedaan, helemaal mentaal. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: Doe het in twee stappen: eerst 18-6, en tel er dan 3 bij.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: В этом задании два шага. Скажи свой ответ.
ru.audio_text: В банке 18 конфет. 6 друзей берут по одной, потом добавляют ещё 3. Сколько конфет теперь?
hints: Сначала отними 6, потом добавь 3 к этому ответу.
ru.worked_example: Произнеси первый ответ вслух. Запомни его. Теперь сделай второй шаг.

feedback.correct: Пятнадцать. Оба шага выполнены верно, полностью в уме. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: Сделай это в два шага: сначала 18-6, потом добавь 3.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Bunun iki adımı var. Cevabını söyle.
tr.audio_text: Bir kavanozda 18 şeker var. 6 arkadaş her biri bir tane alıyor, sonra 3 tane daha ekleniyor. Şimdi kaç şeker var?
hints: Önce 6 çıkar, sonra o cevaba 3 ekle.
tr.worked_example: İlk cevabı yüksek sesle söyle. Zihninde tut. Şimdi ikinci adımı yap.

feedback.correct: On beş. Her iki adım da tamamen zihinden doğru yapıldı. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: İki adımda yap: önce 18-6, sonra 3 ekle.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 这道题有两个步骤。说出你的答案。
hints: 先减6,再给结果加3。
zh.worked_example: 先把第一步的答案说出来,记在心里。现在做第二步。

feedback.correct: 十五。两个步骤都完全在心里正确完成。🍬
feedback.incorrect: 分两步算:先算18-6,再加3。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这一题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: これは2つのステップがあるよ。答えを言おう。
ja.audio_text: 瓶にはあめが18個あります。6人の友達が1個ずつ取り、それから3個追加されました。今、あめは何個ありますか？
hints: まず6を引いて、それからその答えに3を足そう。
ja.worked_example: 最初の答えを声に出して言おう。それを覚えておいて、次のステップをやろう。

feedback.correct: 15。2つのステップを両方、完全に頭の中で正しくできたね。🍬
feedback.incorrect: 2つのステップでやろう。まず18−6、それから3を足そう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 이 문제는 두 단계예요. 답을 말하세요.
ko.audio_text: 병에 사탕 18개가 있어요. 친구 6명이 각각 하나씩 가져가고, 3개를 더 넣어요. 지금 사탕은 몇 개인가요?
hints: 먼저 6을 뺀 다음, 그 답에 3을 더하세요.
ko.worked_example: 첫 번째 답을 소리 내어 말하세요. 기억해 두세요. 이제 두 번째 단계를 하세요.

feedback.correct: 십오. 두 단계 모두 완전히 머릿속으로 정확히 풀었어요. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: 두 단계로 풀어보세요: 먼저 18-6, 그다음 3을 더하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Soal ini punya dua langkah. Ucapkan jawabanmu.
id.audio_text: Sebuah toples punya 18 permen. 6 teman masing-masing mengambil satu, lalu ditambahkan 3 lagi. Berapa permen sekarang?
hints: Kurangi 6 dulu, lalu tambahkan 3 ke jawaban itu.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan jawaban pertama dengan lantang. Simpan dalam pikiranmu. Sekarang kerjakan langkah kedua.

feedback.correct: Lima belas. Kedua langkah dikerjakan dengan benar, sepenuhnya secara mental. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: Kerjakan dalam dua langkah: 18-6 dulu, lalu tambahkan 3.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Câu này có hai bước. Nói đáp án của bạn.
vi.audio_text: Một hũ có 18 cái kẹo. 6 người bạn mỗi người lấy một cái, rồi thêm 3 cái nữa được bỏ vào. Hỏi hiện có bao nhiêu cái kẹo?
hints: Trừ đi 6 trước, rồi cộng thêm 3 vào đáp án đó.
vi.worked_example: Nói to đáp án bước một. Giữ nó trong đầu. Giờ làm bước hai.

feedback.correct: Mười lăm. Cả hai bước đều làm đúng, hoàn toàn bằng tính nhẩm. 🍬
feedback.incorrect: Làm theo hai bước: 18-6 trước, rồi cộng thêm 3.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Math
questions.instruction: This one has two steps. Say your answer.
questions.audio_text: A charity collects 45 pounds on Saturday and 32 on Sunday, then spends 20 on supplies. How much is left?
hints: Add both days first, then take away what was spent.
questions.worked_example: Say the first answer out loud. Hold it in mind. Now do the second step.

feedback.correct: Fifty-seven. Both steps done correctly, entirely mentally, with bigger numbers. 💷
feedback.incorrect: First add 45 and 32, then take away 20 from that total.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: solving and speaking a two-step problem

life_skill.primary: Solving a multi-step money problem mentally
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Real budgets often need adding several sources before subtracting costs, even mentally.

analysis.primary_construct: holding an intermediate spoken result in mind while completing a second step
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The heaviest oral working-memory task in the module - no paper, no typing, just mental tracking and speech.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Speaking only the first step's result is the clearest possible spoken working-memory signature.
analysis.parent_note: Solving two steps entirely in your head and aloud is genuinely demanding - celebrate the attempt.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Encourage saying the first step's answer aloud before starting the second step.

es.instruction: Este tiene dos pasos. Di tu respuesta.
es.audio_text: Una organización benéfica recauda 45 libras el sábado y 32 el domingo, y luego gasta 20 en materiales. ¿Cuánto queda?
hints: Suma primero los dos días, y luego quita lo que se gastó.
es.worked_example: Di la primera respuesta en voz alta. Guárdala en tu mente. Ahora haz el segundo paso.

feedback.correct: Cincuenta y siete. Ambos pasos hechos correctamente, completamente de memoria, con números más grandes. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Primero suma 45 y 32, y luego quita 20 de ese total.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Celui-ci a deux étapes. Dis ta réponse.
fr.audio_text: Une association caritative collecte 45 livres le samedi et 32 le dimanche, puis dépense 20 en fournitures. Combien reste-t-il ?
hints: Additionne d'abord les deux jours, puis enlève ce qui a été dépensé.
fr.worked_example: Dis la première réponse à voix haute. Garde-la en tête. Fais maintenant la deuxième étape.

feedback.correct: Cinquante-sept. Les deux étapes faites correctement, entièrement de tête, avec de plus grands nombres. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Additionne d'abord 45 et 32, puis enlève 20 de ce total.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Esta tem dois passos. Diga a sua resposta.
pt.audio_text: Uma instituição de caridade arrecada 45 libras no sábado e 32 no domingo, depois gasta 20 em suprimentos. Quanto sobra?
hints: Some os dois dias primeiro, depois tire o que foi gasto.
pt.worked_example: Diga a primeira resposta em voz alta. Guarde-a na memória. Agora faça o segundo passo.

feedback.correct: Cinquenta e sete. Os dois passos feitos corretamente, tudo de cabeça, com números maiores. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Primeiro some 45 e 32, depois tire 20 desse total.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Questo ha due passaggi. Di' la tua risposta.
it.audio_text: Un'associazione benefica raccoglie 45 sterline sabato e 32 domenica, poi ne spende 20 in materiali. Quanto resta?
hints: Aggiungi prima entrambi i giorni, poi togli quello che è stato speso.
it.worked_example: Di' la prima risposta ad alta voce. Tienila a mente. Adesso fai il secondo passaggio.

feedback.correct: Cinquantasette. Entrambi i passaggi fatti correttamente, interamente a mente, con numeri più grandi. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Prima aggiungi 45 e 32, poi togli 20 da quel totale.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Diese Aufgabe hat zwei Schritte. Sag deine Antwort.
de.audio_text: Eine Wohltätigkeitsorganisation sammelt am Samstag 45 Pfund und am Sonntag 32, und gibt dann 20 für Material aus. Wie viel bleibt übrig?
hints: Addiere zuerst beide Tage, und zieh dann ab, was ausgegeben wurde.
de.worked_example: Sag die erste Antwort laut. Behalte sie im Kopf. Mach jetzt den zweiten Schritt.

feedback.correct: Siebenundfünfzig. Beide Schritte richtig gemacht, komplett im Kopf, mit größeren Zahlen. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Addiere zuerst 45 und 32, und zieh dann 20 von dieser Summe ab.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen – schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Dit heeft twee stappen. Zeg je antwoord.
nl.audio_text: Een goed doel verzamelt 45 pond op zaterdag en 32 op zondag, en geeft dan 20 uit aan benodigdheden. Hoeveel is er nog over?
hints: Tel beide dagen eerst op, en trek er dan af wat er is uitgegeven.
nl.worked_example: Zeg het eerste antwoord hardop. Houd het in gedachten. Doe nu de tweede stap.

feedback.correct: Zevenenvijftig. Beide stappen correct gedaan, helemaal mentaal, met grotere getallen. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Tel eerst 45 en 32 op, en trek er dan 20 van af.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: В этом задании два шага. Скажи свой ответ.
ru.audio_text: Благотворительная организация собирает 45 фунтов в субботу и 32 в воскресенье, потом тратит 20 на материалы. Сколько осталось?
hints: Сначала сложи оба дня, потом отними то, что потратили.
ru.worked_example: Произнеси первый ответ вслух. Запомни его. Теперь сделай второй шаг.

feedback.correct: Пятьдесят семь. Оба шага выполнены верно, полностью в уме, с большими числами. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Сначала сложи 45 и 32, потом отними 20 от этой суммы.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Bunun iki adımı var. Cevabını söyle.
tr.audio_text: Bir yardım kurumu cumartesi 45 pound, pazar 32 pound topluyor, sonra malzemeler için 20 pound harcıyor. Kaç pound kaldı?
hints: Önce iki günü topla, sonra harcananı çıkar.
tr.worked_example: İlk cevabı yüksek sesle söyle. Zihninde tut. Şimdi ikinci adımı yap.

feedback.correct: Elli yedi. Her iki adım da büyük sayılarla tamamen zihinden doğru yapıldı. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Önce 45 ile 32'yi topla, sonra o toplamdan 20 çıkar.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 这道题有两个步骤。说出你的答案。
hints: 先把两天的数量加起来,再减去花掉的部分。
zh.worked_example: 先把第一步的答案说出来,记在心里。现在做第二步。

feedback.correct: 五十七。即使数字更大,两个步骤也完全在心里正确完成。💷
feedback.incorrect: 先加45和32,再从总数中减20。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这一题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: これは2つのステップがあるよ。答えを言おう。
ja.audio_text: チャリティーは土曜日に45ポンド、日曜日に32ポンド集め、それから物資に20ポンド使いました。残りはいくらですか？
hints: 両方の日の分をまず足して、それから使った分を引こう。
ja.worked_example: 最初の答えを声に出して言おう。それを覚えておいて、次のステップをやろう。

feedback.correct: 57。大きな数字でも、2つのステップを両方、完全に頭の中で正しくできたね。💷
feedback.incorrect: まず45と32を足して、それからその合計から20を引こう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 이 문제는 두 단계예요. 답을 말하세요.
ko.audio_text: 어느 자선단체가 토요일에 45파운드, 일요일에 32파운드를 모으고, 물품에 20파운드를 써요. 얼마가 남았나요?
hints: 먼저 두 날짜의 금액을 더한 다음, 쓴 돈을 빼세요.
ko.worked_example: 첫 번째 답을 소리 내어 말하세요. 기억해 두세요. 이제 두 번째 단계를 하세요.

feedback.correct: 오십칠. 큰 숫자에서도 두 단계 모두 완전히 머릿속으로 정확히 풀었어요. 💷
feedback.incorrect: 먼저 45와 32를 더한 다음, 그 합에서 20을 빼세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Soal ini punya dua langkah. Ucapkan jawabanmu.
id.audio_text: Sebuah badan amal mengumpulkan 45 pound pada hari Sabtu dan 32 pada hari Minggu, lalu menghabiskan 20 untuk perlengkapan. Berapa sisanya?
hints: Tambahkan kedua hari dulu, lalu kurangi apa yang dihabiskan.
id.worked_example: Ucapkan jawaban pertama dengan lantang. Simpan dalam pikiranmu. Sekarang kerjakan langkah kedua.

feedback.correct: Lima puluh tujuh. Kedua langkah dikerjakan dengan benar, sepenuhnya secara mental, dengan angka yang lebih besar. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Tambahkan 45 dan 32 dulu, lalu kurangi 20 dari jumlah itu.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Câu này có hai bước. Nói đáp án của bạn.
vi.audio_text: Một quỹ từ thiện thu được 45 bảng vào thứ Bảy và 32 bảng vào Chủ Nhật, rồi chi 20 bảng cho vật dụng. Hỏi còn lại bao nhiêu?
hints: Cộng cả hai ngày trước, rồi trừ đi số đã chi.
vi.worked_example: Nói to đáp án bước một. Giữ nó trong đầu. Giờ làm bước hai.

feedback.correct: Năm mươi bảy. Cả hai bước đều làm đúng, hoàn toàn bằng tính nhẩm, với số lớn hơn. 💷
feedback.incorrect: Cộng 45 và 32 trước, rồi trừ đi 20 từ tổng đó.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Math

questions.audio_text: A school has 120 pupils. 45 go on a trip and 15 more stay home sick. How many are still at school?
hints: Take away those on the trip, then take away those who are sick too.
questions.worked_example: Say the first answer out loud. Hold it in mind. Now do the second step.

feedback.correct: Sixty. Both groups subtracted correctly, entirely mentally, with bigger numbers. 🏫
feedback.incorrect: First take away 45, then take away 15 more from that answer.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.
